name: pusdatin-kemenag
description: Monorepo Pusdatin Kemenag Barito Utara — Astro frontend + Go Fiber backend

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,magenta" -n "backend,frontend" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run start:web" "npm run start:api"
